S0084.reason: The volume of revolution is given by the integral of the area under the curve times 2ω (pi) from 0 to infinity. The area under y = e^x and y = 2 can be integrated to find the limits of integration, which are 1 and 2. The volume is then the integral from 1 to 2 of (e^x - 2)ω x dx, which equals 2.427.
